    private fun provisionalNames(fields: List<String>): String {
        val centers = "the centers' states (defined, undefined or open)"
        val names = mapOf(
            "type" to "Type", "strategy" to "Strategy", "authority" to "Inner Authority", "profile" to "Profile",
            "definition" to "Definition", "signature" to "the on-track feeling", "notSelfTheme" to "the off-track feeling",
            "incarnationCross" to "Incarnation Cross", "definedCenters" to centers, "undefinedCenters" to centers,
            "openCenters" to centers, "channels" to "Channels",
        )
        val said = fields.mapNotNull { names[it] }.distinct()
        return if (said.size < 2) said.joinToString("") else "${said.dropLast(1).joinToString(", ")} and ${said.last()}"
    }

    fun birthTimeNote(timeKnown: Boolean, spreadChanges: List<String>?): String? {
        val p = provisionalValues(timeKnown, spreadChanges) ?: return null
        val head = "NOTE: birth time was not known and the chart was cast at noon."
        if (p.fields.isEmpty()) {
            return "$head Measured across the whole birth day, every value above holds at any birth time; the page already says so. " +
                "Do not mention the birth time, and never call any value uncertain."
        }
        return "$head ${if (p.measured) "Measured across the whole birth day, these" else "These"} values can change with the birth time: " +
            "${provisionalNames(p.fields)}. Every other value above holds at any birth time. The page already says so; " +
            // 10/23 (= hd-site): "as those values being provisional" came back as "these values are provisional"
            // with none named; the reader is told which.
            "mention it at most once, in plain words, naming every one of those values as provisional. Never call any other value uncertain, " +
            "and add no other caveat about the birth time."
    }
